name: dshd-gui
description: Deepartments GUI/`/deepartments` RPC channel: the PURE server-half dispatcher (dispatchDeepartmentsEndpoint + the 6 endpoints agents/list, host/status, presence/get, presence/set, agenda/list), the client-request envelope validator (parseClientEnvelope), the authority/trust fence (isLoopbackHostname/parseAuthority/isTrustedAuthority/isTrustedHostFact), the thin node:http route handler (handleDeepartmentsRequest) and the client plugin source (src/client/, built to client/client.js via tsdown + the normalize-client-banner envelope) — extracted for the dshd-gui phase of the modular Cordis split. A pure library package (NO cordis plugin, NO tool, NO patch): the bundle keeps the webServer mount effect + the endpointDeps wiring closure (they bind the live apply-fiber registries) and consumes this package through the drop-in bridge src/core/gui.ts. The client inject metadata (dsh.client) mirrors the bundle's so a deployment resolves the SAME client entry.
